reset_release.contract: release phase is 13ns modulo the 16ns period, one ns after sample_clk falls while both clocks are low and three ns before ref_clk rises; smoke asserts at 1ns and releases at 29ns so reset spans at least one ref_clk posedge

reset_assertion.selected_icg_limitation: TLATNCAX2 has no asynchronous reset pin; assertion while sample_clk is high is not owner-equivalent
reset_assertion.activation_rule: retain the frozen low-phase assertion contract or redesign with a reset-capable characterized boundary and requalify all reset domains

staged_boolean_equivalence.rule: clock_o implies frame_active while reset is released
staged_boolean_equivalence.reason: prevent a generated clock used only as redundant drain data from being misclassified as a clock-gating endpoint
